# CANDIDATE: TASK_SCORER_MULTILINE_PRIORITY_FIX

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The task_scorer.py fails to parse priority parentheticals that span multiple physical lines, causing certain candidate markdown files to be silently dropped from leaderboard scoring. This leads to incomplete data and potential omission of viable strategies from consideration. Fixing the parser to join continuation lines before matching will ensure all candidates are processed correctly.

## Mechanism

Modify the ITEM_RE pattern in task_scorer.py to allow the priority field to span multiple lines by preprocessing the input: join lines that start with whitespace (continuation lines) to the previous line before applying the regex. Update the parsing logic to handle the joined string and extract the priority correctly. Add a unit test to verify the fix.

## Pre-merge gate

Existing unit tests for task_scorer.py must pass, plus a new test verifying that priority parentheticals spanning multiple lines (e.g., `CANDIDATE-NAME (HIGH, ...)` with the parenthetical continuing on the next line) are correctly parsed and scored.
